locations.rationale: The dynamicName token denotes the requested property name. Although reading an inaccessible property may invoke __get at runtime, this differently named property token does not semantically resolve to the __get method declaration.

records.rationale: The complete supplied source contains no exact __get identifier token outside the selected declaration. The dynamic property access can trigger the magic method at runtime, but ordinary identifier-reference semantics do not make the property name a usage of the differently named __get declaration.
